svg.text: Spectrum: block size and window of the FFT behind each point.
Band: F min and F max set the frequency band that is summed; Full Bandwidth goes up to Nyquist.
Tacho Tracking: RPM Tracked (axis in rpm) or Free Run (axis in time), Step, Sweep, Hysteresis.
The curve: one point per step, the RMS of the whole band, against rpm or time.
